z0f8dfgx.baseName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
z0f8dfgx.variantName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
z0f8dfgx.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree offers a modern seasonal décor solution for any occasion. Its elegant cone shape and versatile green color seamlessly fit into living rooms, gardens, or terraces, providing an eye-catching focal point without overwhelming the setting. Ideal for those who appreciate contemporary style, this thoughtfully designed product ensures ease of setup with its built-in LED lighting, enhancing its decorative appeal. PVC and Steel Construction Engineered with premium PVC, the tree provides a lightweight yet stable structure that withstands the test of time. The steel components augment the tree's sturdiness, ensuring it remains upright, thus facilitating safe and enjoyable decorating sessions. These materials enhance resilience, promising extended use, season after season, with minimal upkeep required. Integrated LED Lights Enjoy the glow of warm white LED lighting that enriches your atmosphere and resonates with the festive spirit. The energy-efficient LED string lights are artfully distributed across the tree, illuminating every branch and providing a radiant charm that is both subtle and captivating without consuming unnecessary power. USB Power Source Equipped with a USB power connector, this tree provides a convenient and modern way to illuminate your festive ambiance. Plug it into any certified 5V USB power source to instantly bless your space with joyful light. This feature enhances portability, allowing easy placement wherever you desire festive illumination. Decorative Convenience Designed for those who relish aesthetic yet functional designs, this tree celebrates the modern minimalistic style. Its ornamental nature infuses spaces with style and warmth, while also offering practical USB compatibility for a simple power connection, which elevates the overall user experience with its ease of use. Dual-Use Design Perfectly poised for both indoor and outdoor settings, this tree adapts effortlessly to different environments, whether it’s a cozy living room retreat or a holiday-themed terrace. Its flexible design allows for imaginative placement and creative decoration solutions, enhancing spaces with festive cheer and contemporary grace. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and metal Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 110 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips with iridescent decorations Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup, Sturdy metal stand 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on Number of PVC tips: 910 Number of baubles: 120 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

w7zh8nyh.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Black Iridescence Pine Christmas Tree
w7zh8nyh.sourceDescription: Looking for something different this Christmas? Our Black Iridescence tree offers a trendy alternative to traditional Xmas trees. Full, bushy, and packed to the brim with high quality PVC branch tips, this black Christmas tree recreates the stunning look of the naturally growing Black Pine (Pinus Nigra). The Black Iridescence, however, has incredible eye-catching strips of clear iridescent film in the foliage, giving your tree an elegant dark green shimmer. It's a real treat for the eyes when combined with Christmas tree lights and glittering Christmas decorations! Pictures shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. vfavgx4z.sourceDescription: Christmas made extra fun? Yes please. Do it, this season and beyond, with this inflatable gingerbread man from HOMCOM. Our inflatable for Christmas is made for indoor use and outdoor use, thanks to the durable polyester shell, which is IP44 rated for mild water resistance. Inside, there are four LED lights which emit a bright and soft glow - great for night times. This Christmas outdoor decoration is something kids and adults will love all Winter long. ● A happy gingerbread man holds a candy cane and a cup design ● Four inner white LED lights to glow at night ● Plug in to set up - turn off to deflate easily ● IP44 rated polyester shell, safe for mild outdoor weather - peace of mind ● Six ground stakes, two guy ropes and four sandbags to pin to ground, keep it weighted Primary Colour: Orange Type: Inflatable Gingerbread Man Holds a Candy Cane and a Cup Material: Polyester Cloth Overall Dimension: 170W x 75D x 235Hcm Power Cable Length: 3(m) Sandbag Weight: 240g Four LED module lights LED Light Power: 0.5W Fan: DC 12V, 9.6W, 0.8A Input Voltage: AC 220-240V, 50/60Hz, 0.7A Output Voltage: DC 12V, 12W/1A Waterproof Rating: IP44 Item Label: 844-714V70OG NOTE: Blower needs to be plugged in to keep inflatable full. Do not leave plugged in for more than eight hours. Do not use in heavy rain, snow or wind Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
